objective: Map a minimal held-out perturbation/recovery contract onto the existing WP800 public/evaluator boundary and current WP802/WP803/WP804 research/build surfaces, with from-scratch and post-change oracle baselines, transfer-family splits, recovery-cost metrics and fail-closed generation/provenance semantics.

external_evidence_fused.source: Koenig, Likhachev, Furcy — Lifelong Planning A*
external_evidence_fused.mapped_principle: Incremental reuse can reduce replanning work on related changed problems, but only the still-valid part of prior search structure should be reused; F2 should therefore measure valid reuse against a full-replan baseline rather than reward reuse volume itself.

Changing-problem replanning should be compared against solving each problem from scratch under the same problem family; this supports an explicit full-replan comparator, not importing D* Lite as F2 authority.
Repair locality is worth measuring under bounded context/resource budgets, but an external LLM graph-repair framework is not required for the deterministic WP805 benchmark.

external_evidence_fused.source: Emami, Qiang, Graf — World Model Recovery in SFT LLM Planners
external_evidence_fused.mapped_principle: Coverage/family structure can materially affect recovery claims; held-out transfer must therefore be family-bound rather than seed-only.

Prediction similarity alone can hide action-insensitive dynamics; WP805 should optionally use WP803 action-bound predictions as a secondary diagnostic while keeping behavioral recovery as the primary outcome.

WP802.nondependency: WP805 must remain runnable without importing WP802 policy authority; a recovery subject may be any deterministic/public policy adapter that consumes the post-change ObservationView.

reused_surfaces: evaluator-side next-observation scoring after canonical WP800 replay
WP803.nondependency: Prediction accuracy is secondary diagnostic evidence and cannot substitute for post-change task success, recovery cost or transfer evidence.

reused_surfaces: public CandidateGoal boundary and ABSTAIN principle from current architecture fusion
WP804.generation1_rule: Do not make WP805 depend on unaccepted WP804 source. Goal/constraint-change recovery can be added only through a provenance-bound public goal/constraint digest after WP804 has an admitted consumer boundary.

new_types.name: RecoveryScenarioPair
new_types.law: The evaluator may know the exact changed transitions/nodes, but those details are not exposed to the recovery policy unless represented in an admitted public observation/signal.

new_types.name: PublicRecoveryCarryover
new_types.law: Carryover is a frozen candidate artifact from the pre-change run. It is not automatically valid under the post-change generation.

new_types.name: RecoveryPlanCandidate
new_types.law: Candidate construction sees only public post-change state plus explicitly supplied carryover.

new_types.name: RecoveryEvaluation
new_types.law: No benchmark measurement mints world truth, runtime credit, cognition superiority, effect authority or whole-system acceptance.

scenario_construction.reason: WP800 EpisodeState is tightly bound to one fixture SHA/generation. Pairing immutable before/after fixtures preserves its fail-closed invariants and avoids adding in-place world mutation or a second state authority.
prechange_phase: run a deterministic public policy on fixture A
freeze the public carryover at a declared boundary before completion
record remaining candidate plan/state digest only
postchange_phase: start a new WP800 episode on fixture B whose initial public observation represents the matched recovery point
fixture B must have a new generation and public fixture digest
provide the same post-change ObservationView to both FULL_REPLAN and SELECTIVE_REPAIR arms
only SELECTIVE_REPAIR receives the frozen public carryover
matched_fairness: same public goal/constraint digest when such a field is admitted

oracle_design.postchange_oracle: Evaluator-side bounded shortest-valid-action search over the deterministic hidden WP800 graph from the post-change initial evaluator node to an admitted successful terminal node.
fail_closed: if no successful terminal is reachable, classify scenario UNSCORABLE_FOR_PATH_REGRET rather than invent an oracle
if multiple shortest paths exist, score path length/outcome rather than syntactic identity
oracle result must bind exact post-change fixture SHA/generation

full_replan_baseline.definition: Same policy/planner class, same post-change public inputs and same budget, but no pre-change carryover artifact.
full_replan_baseline.purpose: Separate genuine reusable recovery from simply solving the changed problem again.
anti_cheat: do not allow FULL_REPLAN to inspect evaluator-only changed edges/nodes
do not allow SELECTIVE_REPAIR extra hidden signals
do not compare different model/provider classes without a separately declared efficiency normalization

transfer_split_contract.split_law: A transfer claim must hold out at least one declared family axis. A new random seed within the same family is reproducibility, not structural transfer.
transfer_split_contract.leakage_falsifier: Train/tune/select on all but one perturbation/topology family, then verify that no fixture/source/donor/method-family digest from the held-out family appears in the selection corpus or policy configuration.

primary_metrics: excess actions versus post-change evaluator oracle
action delta versus matched full-replan baseline
invalid or stale action attempts after the declared change
validated retained-action count and invalid-retained-action count
probe/model-call/token/latency/resource deltas when the SUT actually uses those resources
metric_nonclaims: plan edit distance is not a primary metric
high reuse fraction is not success if retained actions are invalid
fewer model calls do not compensate for worse task success unless an explicit cost-quality frontier is reported
WP803 prediction score does not equal behavioral recovery
repository benchmark efficiency does not equal VPS/runtime efficiency
required_falsifiers: EARLY_DEPENDENCY_BREAK: invalidate a dependency near the start of the remaining plan; stale reuse must be penalized and cannot score as efficient simply because it preserved many actions
IRRELEVANT_LOCAL_CHANGE: change a hidden region not on the current valid path; selective repair should not be forced to discard the entire plan
FULL_REPLAN_WINS_SMALL_WORLD: construct a tiny fixture where bookkeeping/reuse gives no benefit; WP805 must allow NEUTRAL/NEGATIVE architecture benefit
GENERATION_DRIFT_FAILS_CLOSED: carryover bound to fixture generation g must not be consumed as if valid for g+1 without explicit recovery validation
OBSERVATION_DIGEST_DRIFT_FAILS_CLOSED: mutate/rebind the post-change public observation after candidate construction and require rejection
FAMILY_LEAKAGE_REJECTED: held-out family identity appearing in training/selection material invalidates transfer credit
ORACLE_HIDDEN: any SUT-visible field that reveals evaluator path/changed-edge identity invalidates the fixture
EQUIVALENT_PLAN: two different shortest action sequences with equal outcome/path length must receive equal oracle-regret credit
WP803_ACTION_SENSITIVITY_OPTIONAL: a policy with strong next-observation similarity but action-insensitive predictions must not receive recovery credit unless behavior succeeds
architecture_implications: Do not import LPA*, D* Lite, WM-SAR, ActSWM or a new planning framework into F2 for WP805 generation 1.
The smallest dependency-correct design is evaluator infrastructure plus thin public candidate/carryover types over WP800.
Use immutable before/after fixtures instead of mutating a live EpisodeState; this preserves existing provenance/generation fences.
Keep WP802 and WP803 as optional comparator/diagnostic adapters, not mandatory authority dependencies.
Keep WP804 goal-change recovery conditional until its public consumer boundary is admitted.
Repair locality and resource efficiency should be measured, not assumed to be beneficial.

counterhypotheses.statement: For the current small deterministic micro-worlds, from-scratch replanning may be simpler and cheaper than maintaining recovery carryover.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: FULL_REPLAN_WINS_SMALL_WORLD matched case; if selective repair does not improve any declared cost metric at equal success, do not promote reuse machinery.

counterhypotheses.statement: A paired-fixture design may fail to model true mid-episode recovery because the new episode boundary resets state that a deployed system would retain.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: If generation-1 paired fixtures show a meaningful recovery signal, later add a separately claimed E4 ablation comparing paired-fixture recovery with an explicit generation-safe resume boundary; do not widen WP800 before that evidence exists.

counterhypotheses.statement: WP803 prediction diagnostics may add complexity without predicting behavioral recovery.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Measure correlation only as secondary analysis; remove it from WP805 acceptance if it does not discriminate successful from failed recovery.
